intent: new original flat albedo atlas proof
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a production-ready flat ALBEDO TEXTURE ATLAS for selected surfaces on a real 3D pixel-cel orbital courier workshop. This is a new original bitmap surface asset, not a scene illustration, prop render, UI sheet, SVG, or perspective drawing.

Create one square 1024 x 1024 pixel texture atlas, full bleed, with precise orthogonal rectangular tile boundaries. Pixel-art paint treatment, crisp nearest-neighbor-like pixel steps on one consistent fine grid, very sparse deliberate edge chips and signs of handling. At least 85 percent of each tile must remain a quiet broad solid-color paint or kraft area. Restrained sophisticated palette: deep navy #21375A, cobalt #31527D, blue-gray #536F91, warm kraft #B58B5F and #D4AF78, cream #EFD8AD, ochre/yellow #E8AF30. Use only subtle flat color variation, not photographic grain or noise.

EXACT ATLAS LAYOUT:
Left half, x=0..511: four wide drawer-front strips stacked at y=0..127, 128..255, 256..383, 384..511. They are navy/cobalt painted metal, each with a few small worn paint chips near one or two corners and one small cream maintenance label or route tick. They have NO drawn handles, bolts, raised rims, or 3D edges because those exist in the model. Each strip is overwhelmingly quiet paint, with labels occupying under 8 percent of its area.
Left half, y=512..767: one wider cobalt utility-cabinet face, sparse light blue paint rubs near corners, one small cream service label reading only "07" and a tiny ochre horizontal mark.
Left half, y=768..1023: one ochre maintenance-trim surface, mostly clean flat ochre with a restrained short navy diagonal warning pattern near one end and a couple small exposed darker paint chips.

Right half, x=512..1023: a regular 2-column by 4-row grid of square 256 x 256 tiles. First three rows are six different warm kraft PARCEL FACE textures. Each has a cream postage/shipping label, a small original navy routing symbol made of a circle and short diagonal stroke, a few short flat route bars, a restrained tape band, and only sparse folded-paper edge marks. Vary the label size and placement and the kraft base color. No personal addresses, no real brands, no familiar logos, no QR codes, no seals copied from any postal service. Short route text may be only "A2", "03", or "07"; no other readable text.
The bottom-right grid row has two painted service-panel tiles: left cobalt with a small cream maintenance sticker, right ochre with a short navy warning accent. Keep them quiet and flat.

Lighting: NONE. This is unlit albedo color only. No directional light, gradients, shine, reflections, beveled-edge shading, ambient occlusion, cast shadows, light halos, lit/dark sides, or 3D volume. No drop shadows beneath labels. Every texture is a perfectly flat front-on paint/paper surface.
Constraints: fill the entire canvas with the atlas tiles, with clean exact straight boundaries and no surrounding border, no title, no legend, no grid-line overlay, no extra icons outside the surfaces, no full scene, no characters, no spacecraft. Avoid random speckle, dense scratches, grunge overlays, repeated tiny decoration, blurry edges, dithering, and glossy plastic. This atlas will be UV-mapped sparingly onto a few existing modeled drawer faces and parcels; the engine supplies all real lighting and shadows.
approval_status: first proof only; parent inspection required before UV application
